pages.title: Sample: About
pages.excerpt: Demo page — verify slug routes and .dkit-prose rendering.
pages.body:
This is sample seed data from the pages module. Rewrite or remove it in Directus when you add real pages.

What to verify

Open this slug in your app (for example /about or /pages/about, depending on the base path you chose at install).

Use this page to smoke-test install — then replace it with your own content before launch.

Exercises

  • Detail UI loads title and body
  • WYSIWYG HTML picks up .dkit-prose
  • Unpublished drafts stay hidden from the public role

Next steps

  1. Edit this page in Site → Pages
  2. Create another page with a new slug
  3. Wire routes to getPageBySlug

Replace all sample content before launch.

pages.title: Sample: Hello
pages.excerpt: Second demo page for base-path and multi-page checks.
pages.body:
Hello

Second sample page so you can click between slugs. With base path / this is /hello; with /pages it is /pages/hello.

Included markup

  • Headings
  • Inline code for paths
  • A short list

Confirm both sample slugs resolve, then delete the demos when you no longer need them.

Delete when you no longer need the demo.
